cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 102, a flight from Wuhan to Guangzhou, you are at gate 213, you have got information Kilo, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 102，从武汉飞往广州，在 213 号登机口，已收到通播 Kilo，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN3102, gate 213, information K, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN3102，213 号登机口，通播 K，请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, Lima Kilo Oscar 02 departure, initial altitude 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.75, squawk 2736.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，使用跑道 36R，Lima Kilo Oscar 02 离场，起始高度 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.75，应答机 2736。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, LKO 02 departure, initial altitude 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.75, squawk 2736, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，使用跑道 36R，LKO 02 离场，起始高度 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.75，应答机 2736，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3102, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN3102，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, push back and start up approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，同意推出和开车，机头朝北。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing north, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，机头朝北，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: B: During engine start up, your APU has malfunctioned, ask Wuhan Ground to start 1 engine at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：开车过程中，你的 APU 故障，请求武汉地面在登机口启动 1 台发动机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3102, request start 1 engine at the gate due APU malfunction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN3102，因 APU 故障，请求在登机口启动 1 台发动机。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, start 1 engine at the gate approved, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，同意在登机口启动 1 台发动机，准备滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: Start 1 engine at the gate approved, wilco, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意在登机口启动 1 台发动机，照办，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have started up your engines, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已启动发动机，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3102, start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN3102，开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, hold position, give way to Boeing 747 passing from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，原地等待，避让从左至右经过的 Boeing 747。
cards.referenceText: Holding position, give way to B747 passing from left to right, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，避让从左至右经过的 B747，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, traffic passed and clear, continue taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，飞机已通过并脱离，继续滑行。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
B: Now you are approaching holding point runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower and tell the controller you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正接近跑道 36R 等待点，联系武汉塔台并告诉管制员你准备好起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3102, approaching holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN3102，接近跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, hold short of runway 36R, expect 15 minutes delay due thunderstorm approaching the upwind of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，跑道 36R 外等待，因雷暴接近跑道 36R 上风边，预计延误 15 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold short of runway 36R, CSN3102.

cards.audioText: B: After ten minutes, you find you need to refuel the aircraft due to a long time delay, you have to taxi back for refueling the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: B：十分钟后，由于长时间延误，你发现需要给飞机加油，必须滑回给飞机加油。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3102, request taxi back for refueling the aircraft due to long time delay.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN3102，因长时间延误，请求滑回给飞机加油。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, enter runway 36R, vacate runway via Alpha 2, then Tango 5 to gate 211.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，进入跑道 36R，经 Alpha 2 脱离跑道，然后经 Tango 5 到 211 号登机口。
cards.referenceText: Enter runway 36R, vacate runway via A2, then T5 to gate 211, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 36R，经 A2 脱离跑道，然后经 T5 到 211 号登机口，CSN3102。
